nodes.name: Ni foam pretreatment
nodes.procedure: The operations of oil removal and oxide layer removal were conducted, which has been presented in previous work[37].
nodes.source_text: The operations of oil removal and oxide layer removal were conducted... previous work[37].

nodes.name: Chemical plating
nodes.procedure: Ni foam was immersed in the chemical plating solution at 80°C for 1 h. The chemical plating solution contained 15gL-1 FeSO4·7H2O, 15gL-1 NiSO4·6H2O, 150gL-1 NaH2PO2·H2O, 20gL-1 NaSO4, 30gL-1 H3BO3 and 60gL-1 Na3C6H5O7·2H2O. The NaOH was used to modulate pH to 10.
nodes.source_text: The chemical plating solution contained 15gL-1 FeSO4·7H2O... Ni foam was immersed in the chemical plating solution at 80°C for 1 h.

unit_operations.name: Solution preparation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: The chemical plating solution contained 15gL-1 FeSO4·7H2O, 15gL-1 NiSO4·6H2O, 150gL-1 NaH2PO2·H2O, 20gL-1 NaSO4, 30gL-1 H3BO3 and 60gL-1 Na3C6H5O7·2H2O. The NaOH was used to modulate pH to 10.

unit_operations.name: Immersion plating
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Ni foam was immersed in the chemical plating solution at 80°C for 1 h.

nodes.name: Annealing crystallization
nodes.procedure: To obtain clean crystalline (Ni1-xFex)3P, the product of chemical plating was annealed at 400°C for 4 h in the Ar environment then at 600°C for 35 min in H2 and Ar environment.
nodes.source_text: To obtain clean crystalline (Ni1-xFex)3P, the product of chemical plating was annealed at 400°C for 4 h in the Ar environment then at 600°C for 35 min in H2 and Ar environment.

unit_operations.name: Ar annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: the product of chemical plating was annealed at 400°C for 4 h in the Ar environment

unit_operations.name: H2/Ar annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: then at 600°C for 35 min in H2 and Ar environment.

nodes.name: Superaerophobic etching
nodes.procedure: The superaerophobic heterostructure of (Ni1-xFex)3P/NiFe -OH was synthesized by etching the (Ni1-xFex)3P in 2.5M KOH at 80°C for 5 h.
nodes.source_text: The superaerophobic heterostructure of (Ni1-xFex)3P/NiFe -OH was synthesized by etching the (Ni1-xFex)3P in 2.5M KOH at 80°C for 5 h.

nodes.description: OER stability measurement at constant potential (100 mA/cm²)

working_electrode.value: Ni foam (1 cm × 1 cm) with 2.7 mg catalyst loading

nodes.source_text: For stability measurement, i-t curves were obtained in a three electrode system in 1 M KOH with a constant potential. As shown in Figure 5b, the current density drops drastically from 101 mA cm^{-2} to 40.7 mA cm^{-2} after 30 h measurement... The as-synthesized (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P exhibits an overpotential of 284 mV at the current density of 10 mA cm^{-2}.

nodes.description: OER performance and 120h stability of superaerophobic heterostructure

working_electrode.value: Ni foam (1 cm × 1 cm) with catalyst

nodes.source_text: The reverse scan results of IR-corrected cyclic voltammetry (CV) curves (Figure 8a) obtained in 1 M KOH solution show that the superaerophobic heterostructure presents an overpotential of 233 mV at the current density of 10 mA cm^{-2}... The i-t curve in Figure 8b indicates that after 120 h measurement, the current density only exhibits a slight decrease from 120 to 100 mA cm^{-2}

nodes.characterization_summary: As-deposited coating is ~500 nm thick with rough surface; after 30 h OER, ~100 nm self-reconstruction layer forms with flat surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 1b, the as-deposited coating is ∼500 nm thick. Figure 1c presents that the coating uniformly grows on the nickel foam with rough surface ... After 30 h OER measurement, a self-construction layer (∼100 nm) forms on the coating (Figure 1d) with the surface becoming flat (Figure 1e).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows diffraction peaks at 41.8°, 42.8°, 43.6°, 45.2°, 46°, 46.6°, 50.5° and 52.7° indexed to (231), (330), (112), (240), (202), (141), (222) and (132) planes of Ni_3P; no Fe-related peaks detected; no obvious change after 30 h OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 1f, the X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of the powder sample scratched from the nickel foam exhibits the diffraction peaks at 41.8°, 42.8°, 43.6°, 45.2°, 46°, 46.6°, 50.5° and 52.7°, which could be indexed to the (231), (330), (112), (240), (202), (141), (222) and (132) planes of Ni_3P, respectively. ... After 30 h OER measurement, no obvious change in the XRD pattern is found.

nodes.characterization_summary: -OH groups peak greatly enhanced after OER measurement, attributed to (NiFe)OOH-P generation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FTIR spectra in Figure S2a present that the peak of -OH groups is greatly enhanced after the measurement, which could be attributed to the generation of (NiFe)OOH-P during OER.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p_{3/2}: metallic Ni 852.57 eV, Ni^{x+} 855.66 eV, satellite 860.63 eV; after 30h OER metallic Ni decreases (852.7 eV), Ni^{x+} and satellite intensify with positive shift. Fe 2p_{3/2}: metallic Fe 706.8 eV, Fe^{3+} 712.6 eV; after OER metallic Fe decreases, Fe^{3+} intensifies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) spectra in Figure 1g and 1h, a peak at 852.57 eV for the Ni XPS spectrum of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P could be indexed to the 2p_{3/2} region of metallic Ni, while the other two peaks at 855.66 eV and 860.63 eV ... After 30 h measurement, the intensity of the metallic Ni (852.7 eV) greatly decreases ... The Fe XPS spectrum of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P in 2p_{3/2} region (Figure 1h) shows two peaks at 706.8 eV and 712.6 eV ... After OER measurement, the catalyst with reconstructed heterostructure exhibits a low intensity of metallic Fe peak and a more intense Fe^{3+} peak.

nodes.characterization_summary: Single-crystal (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P with ~500 nm grain size; after 30 h OER, amorphous self-reconstruction layer (~100 nm) forms on surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM image in Figure 2a and the corresponding selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) in Figure 2c exhibit an obvious single-crystal feature of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P with a grain size of ∼500 nm. ... After 30 h OER measurement, a self-construction layer is found on the surface (Figure 2g).

nodes.characterization_summary: Lattice distance of 0.217 nm indexed to (231) plane of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P; after OER, two distinct regions: crystalline (231) plane and amorphous reconstruction layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image in Figure 2b shows a lattice distance of 0.217 nm, which could be indexed to the (231) plane of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P. ... The HRTEM image (Figure 2h) presents clear two divided parts.

nodes.characterization_summary: Single-crystal feature of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P maintained after 30 h OER, confirming amorphous nature of reconstruction layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SAED pattern in Figure 2i still shows an obvious single-crystal feature of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P, further proving the amorphous nature of self-construction layer.

nodes.characterization_summary: Before OER: uniform Ni, Fe, P distribution, Fe/Ni=12.99%, P/Ni=37.96%; after 30 h OER: Fe/Ni=8.83%, P/Ni=35.83% in bulk, self-layer shows only Ni signal.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The corresponding energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) in Figure 2 d~f show that the Ni, Fe and P elements are uniformly distributed, and the Fe/Ni ratio is 12.99%, while the P/Ni ratio is 37.96% (Table S2). ... The Fe/Ni ratio decreases to 8.83%, while the P/Ni ratio decreases to 35.83% (Table S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS shows low Fe&P dissolution from protected (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P; significantly higher dissolution after etching protective layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ICP-MS measurements for (c) Fe and (d) P concentrations in the electrolyte during the OER test at the current density of 100 mA cm^{-2}.

nodes.characterization_summary: After 30 h: peaks at 463.1 and 559.7 cm^{-1} attributed to e_g bending and A_{1g} stretching of Ni-O in NiOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the sample after 30 h test, the Raman peaks at 463.1 and 559.7 cm^{-1} are attributed to the e_g bending vibration and the A_{lg} stretching vibration of Ni-O in NiOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Untested electrode surface contact angle 135.2°; decreases to 121.1° after 30 h OER due to surface flattening.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The contact angle of the untested electrode surface is 135.2° (Figure 4a), and the surface contact angle decreases to 121.1° after 30 h (Figure 4b), which could be attributed to the change in surface roughness.

nodes.characterization_summary: R_ct increases from 12.46 Ω to 14.27 Ω after 30 h OER due to O2 bubble adsorption; decreases to 9.12 Ω after O2 removal.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As presented in Figure 5f, the transfer resistance (R_ct) of (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P obviously increases from 12.46 Ω to 14.27 Ω after 30 h measurement ... After removing the O2 bubbles, the R_ct decreases to 9.12 Ω.

nodes.characterization_summary: Superaerophobic heterostructure C_dl = 4.675 mF cm^{-2}, 3x higher than original (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P (1.41 mF cm^{-2}).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemical active surface area (ECSA) result of the superaerophobic electrode (Figure 8f) show 3 times higher C_dl (4.675 mF cm^{-2}) than the original (Ni_{1 - x}Fe_x)_3P (1.41 mF cm^{-2}).
